mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine (sympathomimetic) combined with levodopa (dopamine precursor) increases risk of cardiovascular stimulation, arrhythmias, and hypertensive crisis due to synergistic catecholaminergic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor closely for hypertension, tachycardia, and arrhythmias; consider alternative ADHD medications with lower sympathomimetic activity.
